# SemanticVersion

A semantic version, as its three numeric core components.

```rux
pub struct SemanticVersion {
    pub major: uint;
    pub minor: uint;
    pub patch: uint;
}
```

Carries the core only: a pre-release tag or build metadata is not represented, so two versions differing only in
those compare equal. Copy, owns nothing, and allocates nothing.
Ordered by precedence, major component first, as semantic versioning defines it.

## Fields

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                 |
| ------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `major` | `uint` | The major component, which changes when compatibility does. |
| `minor` | `uint` | The minor component.                                        |
| `patch` | `uint` | The patch component.                                        |

## Constructors

<h3 id="new"><code>SemanticVersion</code></h3>

```rux
pub func SemanticVersion(
    major: uint,
    minor: uint,
    patch: uint
) -> SemanticVersion
```

Constructs a version with the given components.
All three are read by value; the version is returned by copy and borrows nothing.
Cannot fail: every triple of components is a version. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

| Name    | Type   | Description       |
| ------- | ------ | ----------------- |
| `major` | `uint` | the major version |
| `minor` | `uint` | the minor version |
| `patch` | `uint` | the patch version |

**Returns**: the version

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Compiler.rux#L29)

## Methods

<h3 id="compare"><code>Compare</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Compare(
    self: &SemanticVersion,
    other: SemanticVersion
) -> int
```

Compares precedence with `other`.
`self` is borrowed and `other` is read by value. Returns a negative value when `self` precedes `other`, zero
when the two have the same precedence, and a positive value when `self` follows it. Components are compared
major first, and the first difference decides.
Cannot fail. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

| Name    | Type              | Description                  |
| ------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `other` | `SemanticVersion` | the value to compare against |

**Returns**: how this value orders against `other`

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Compiler.rux#L41)
